title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final ratio of mean densities of the Earth and the Sun as 3.31.

title: Use of Gravitational Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the gravitational law to relate the masses and distances involved.

title: Angular Diameter Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the distance to the Sun using the angular diameter.

title: Density Ratio Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the density ratio using the relationships established in the problem.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in equations, particularly when applying gravitational formulas.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants and conversion factors, are included in calculations.
